new_assertions.title: relative endpoint phase equals the distinguished residual bit
new_assertions.body: For each shortest route in every satisfying residual-bit-refined assignment, target_phase XOR source_phase equals the final P0 residual-token-197700 membership bit.

new_assertions.title: the local residual correction is independent of absolute phase gauge
new_assertions.body: Simultaneously complementing source and target phase bits leaves target_phase XOR source_phase unchanged; therefore the equality in SC-IA048 is invariant under the only global-complement gauge freedom of the refined shortest witness.

new_assertions.title: the corrected local relation survives observed transporter/history difference
new_assertions.body: The two shortest routes have different full transporters and different source-frame action histories, yet both satisfy the same gauge-invariant relation target_phase XOR source_phase = final residual-token-197700 membership; those observed transporter/history differences do not prevent this state-local relative relation on the two-route family.

add_fixed: the shortest two-route family admits a history-free gauge-invariant relative phase relation expressed by an endpoint residual-membership bit
retain_open: whether such an intrinsic endpoint relation exists for every 5x4 obstruction
whether transition orientation is required outside the shortest family
whether a relabeling-invariant residual predicate can replace the frozen representative token

rejected_candidates.body: All transporter/orientation information is irrelevant to the corrected generalized carrier.
rejected_candidates.reason: Only the shortest two-route family has a state-local correction independent of its observed transporter/history difference.

rejected_candidates.body: The frozen residual token 197700 is a gauge-independent generalized coordinate.
rejected_candidates.reason: The phase equation is independent of absolute phase gauge, but the token itself remains tied to the frozen canonical representative; relabeling-invariant formulation is still open.
